summary: INLIF Limited, a Cayman-incorporated China-based industrial machinery issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing termination, effective September 19, 2026, of its March 12, 2026 at-the-market sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC covering up to $100,000,000 of Class A ordinary shares. Under the program the company sold 196,246,521 Class A shares pre-consolidation (about 981,261 post the 1-for-200 consolidation of July 6, 2026), raising roughly $21.15 million net, with about $2.14 million in agent compensation. No further sales may occur; shares outstanding are 1,046,390 Class A and 43,908 Class B. This is a routine shelf-takedown termination, not a special situation.
